name: Idea → Writer → video
about: Where to start: the idea and the heroine are already filled in and connected to the Writer. «Write», «Expand into scenes», «Shoot all».

data.text:
How to use it.

1. Idea — a couple of phrases in your language: who, where, what happens, how it ends. Adjust it to your video.
2. Heroine — the look and outfit in English are already filled in. Your own photo: «Hero's photo» → «Describe from photo». The hero can be removed — the Writer will invent one.
3. Writer — pick the length, mood, music and press «Write» (about a minute). The scenes appear as a list in your language.
4. «Expand into scenes» — prompts, scenes, a join and an output appear on the right.
5. Click the empty canvas → «Draft» → «Shoot all». The video is in the «Output».

Changed the idea or the heroine — the Writer gets marked «Rewrite». What to do with a node — the «Next» line in its panel.

data.title: Idea
data.text: A young barista closes a small café late in the evening, rain outside the window. She wipes the counter, turns off the lights and finds a note from a customer on a table — and smiles.
